title: Odd-weight short-proof PCPP system
statement: For each natural number $m$, define a PCPP system over the Boolean alphabet with input length $m+2$, proof length $m$, and three verifier queries. Its verifier uses the seed space, seed distribution, and acceptance rule of the odd-weight partial-sum PCPP system at parameter $m$; each query is obtained by omitting the final true-proof query, and acceptance is evaluated after restoring the corresponding true-proof value in the transcript.
